messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`; script currently ends immediately after story data.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; implement missing event wiring and flows for campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix errors, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, script foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot helper; inspect before use.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; `STORY` begins near line 1,978, and the script ends at the file end with no runtime logic afterward.
- Existing code references undefined routines such as `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`; event wiring is missing.
- Chromium and Node.js are available.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Reviewed relevant sections of `index.html` and the screenshot helper; confirmed the script ends after `STORY` without runtime logic.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; implement missing event wiring and flows for campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, script foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; `STORY` begins near line 1,978, and the script ends at the file end with no runtime logic afterward.
- Existing code references undefined routines such as `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`; event wiring is missing.
- Chromium and Node.js are available.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Confirmed the script ends after `STORY` without runtime logic; existing references include undefined routines such as `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`, and event wiring is missing.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; implement missing event wiring and flows for campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, script foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; `STORY` begins near line 1,978, and the script ends at the file end with no runtime logic afterward.
- Chromium and Node.js are available.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; implement missing event wiring and flows for campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, script foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; `STORY` begins near line 1,978, and the script ends at the file end with no runtime logic afterward.
- Chromium and Node.js are available.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; implement missing event wiring and flows for campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, script foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; `STORY` begins near line 1,978, and the script ends at the file end with no runtime logic afterward.
- Chromium and Node.js are available.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; implement missing event wiring and flows for campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, script foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper; uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; `STORY` begins near line 1,978, and the script ends at the file end with no runtime logic afterward.
- Chromium and Node.js are available.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` includes extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`; the script currently ends immediately after the story array.
- Validate placeholders and choice effects; wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, script foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; the script ends at line 2841 after `STORY`, with no runtime logic afterward.
- Existing runtime foundations include `App`, `showScreen`, `toast`, modal helpers, `Audio1`, `Scene`, `SURVIVORS`, `DIFFICULTIES`, `CONTROL_THEMES`, `ENDINGS`, `ACHIEVEMENTS`, `CODEX`, and `STORY`.
- Chromium and Node.js are available.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected foundational runtime code, campaign data, and sample story entries, including resource effects, risk/failure effects, and gender/name placeholder conventions.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`; the script currently ends immediately after the story array.
- Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects; wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data and wire up the required screens and interactions.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; the script ends after `STORY`, with no runtime logic afterward.
- Existing runtime foundations include `App`, `showScreen`, `toast`, modal helpers, `Audio1`, `Scene`, `SURVIVORS`, `DIFFICULTIES`, `CONTROL_THEMES`, `ENDINGS`, `ACHIEVEMENTS`, `CODEX`, and `STORY`.
- Chromium and Node.js are available.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected foundational runtime code, campaign data, sample story entries, and identified placeholder conventions and choice effects.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`; the script currently ends immediately after the story array.
- Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects; wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data and wire up the required screens and interactions.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; the script ends after `STORY`, with no runtime logic afterward.
- Existing runtime foundations include `App`, `showScreen`, `toast`, modal helpers, `Audio1`, `Scene`, `SURVIVORS`, `DIFFICULTIES`, `CONTROL_THEMES`, `ENDINGS`, `ACHIEVEMENTS`, `CODEX`, and `STORY`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected foundational runtime code, campaign data, sample story entries, and identified placeholder conventions and choice effects.

### Active
- Implement runtime application logic after `STORY`; the script currently ends immediately after the story array.
- Validate story data, including gender/name placeholders and choice effects; wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic.
2. Validate story data and wire up the required screens and interactions.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; the script ends after `STORY`, with no runtime logic afterward.
- Existing runtime foundations include `App`, `showScreen`, `toast`, modal helpers, `Audio1`, `Scene`, `SURVIVORS`, `DIFFICULTIES`, `CONTROL_THEMES`, `ENDINGS`, `ACHIEVEMENTS`, `CODEX`, and `STORY`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Foundational runtime code, campaign data, sample story entries, and choice-effect conventions have been inspected.

### Active
- Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic; the script currently ends immediately after the story array.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Validate story data and wire up the required screens and interactions.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; the script ends after `STORY`, with no runtime logic afterward.
- Existing runtime foundations include `App`, `showScreen`, `toast`, modal helpers, `Audio1`, `Scene`, `SURVIVORS`, `DIFFICULTIES`, `CONTROL_THEMES`, `ENDINGS`, `ACHIEVEMENTS`, `CODEX`, and `STORY`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Foundational runtime code, campaign data, sample story entries, and choice-effect conventions have been inspected.

### Active
- Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic; the script currently ends immediately after the story array.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Validate story data and wire up the required screens and interactions.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; the script ends after `STORY`, with no runtime logic afterward.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Foundational runtime code, campaign data, sample story entries, and choice-effect conventions have been inspected.

### Active
- Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic; the script currently ends immediately after the story array.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Validate story data and wire up the required screens and interactions.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; the script ends after `STORY`, with no runtime logic afterward.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Foundational runtime code, campaign data, sample story entries, and choice-effect conventions have been inspected.

### Active
- Extend `index.html` after `STORY` with application and gameplay logic; the script currently ends immediately after the story array.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; wire up campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, and notifications.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Validate story data and wire up the required screens and interactions.
3. Launch in Chromium, test primary flows, fix issues, and save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `index.html` has 2,843 lines; the script ends after `STORY`, with no runtime logic afterward.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate the game in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected key UI, settings, scene renderer, survivor/endings/story structures, and the final story entry.

### Active
- Add application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing code references runtime components such as `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect their expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

## `index.html` findings

Inspected `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`. The app appears to be a single-file UI and renderer, but it does **not** contain the complete runtime that its rendering paths expect.

### Scene rendering

- `SceneRenderer` draws the animated canvas `#scene` (around lines 748 and 1409–1503).
- In sandbox mode, it delegates drawing to `Sandbox.draw(ctx, this.w, this.h, dt, this.t)` when `Sandbox.active` is true. Otherwise, it renders a dimmed menu scene.
- Campaign rendering reads `Campaign.run.act`; survivor rendering accesses `Campaign.run.survivor.gender` (around lines 1702–1705 and 1818–1821).
- `showScreen()` switches among menu, campaign, sandbox, ranking, archive, options, credits, and ending screens, and also changes audio/scene modes (lines 1340–1357).

### UI and controls

- Main menu action attributes include `campaign`, `sandbox`, `ranking`, `archive`, `options`, and `credits` (lines 784–825).
- The campaign HUD and choice UI include IDs for vitals, oxygen, trust, and signal bars, plus the choice prompt, timer, list, and note (lines 831–865).
- Sandbox controls include `sb-start`, `sb-vital`, `sb-hostiles`, `sb-score`, configurable `sb-*` inputs, and power buttons with `data-sbpower` values `stasis`, `shield`, and `overcharge` (lines 870–923).
- Ranking has campaign/sandbox tabs; the other screen markup includes archive, options, credits, and ending (lines 927–993).

### Settings and persistence

- Storage keys are `todesfunk.settings.v2`, `todesfunk.campaign.v2`, `todesfunk.ranking.v2`, and `todesfunk.archive.v2` (lines 1031–1035).
- Settings defaults and application logic are around lines 1106–1173.
- The file includes a synthesized `AudioEngine`.

### Story data and effects

- `STORY` starts around line 1978 and contains seven acts.
- Choice effects use keys including `tr`, `sig`, `vit`, `o2`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`. Choices may also specify `risk`, `fail`, `failReply`, and `ending`.
- **Data inconsistency:** one choice uses `trust: 0` rather than the otherwise common `tr` key (around line 2096). If the campaign logic only processes `tr`, that effect may be ignored.

### Required runtime interfaces

The renderer expects external globals or modules to provide:

- `Sandbox.active` and `Sandbox.draw(ctx, width, height, dt, time)`.
- `Campaign.run.act` and `Campaign.run.survivor.gender`.

The file does not appear to define `Campaign` or `Sandbox`, or to include an app boot/init routine. It also contains no in-file event-handler wiring for the menu, navigation, or sandbox action attributes; the only `addEventListener` match found was the renderer’s resize handler (around line 1421). Those pieces therefore need to be supplied elsewhere for the UI and game flow to function.

### Likely pitfalls

- **Missing runtime globals:** campaign or sandbox rendering can fail if the required `Campaign` or `Sandbox` interfaces are unavailable.
- **Insufficient campaign guard:** `drawCampaignSurvivor` directly accesses `Campaign.run` (around line 1820), so guarding an earlier act lookup does not prevent an error when `Campaign` itself is missing.
- **Unwired controls:** markup attributes alone do not trigger actions; the corresponding event listeners or delegated handlers are not present in this file.
- **Effect-key mismatch:** the `trust`/`tr` inconsistency may cause a story choice effect to be silently skipped.
</subagent>

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate the game in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected key UI, settings, scene renderer, survivor/endings/story structures, and the final story entry.

### Active
- Add application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing code references runtime components such as `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect their expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected UI structure, key element IDs, scene renderer, settings, survivor/endings/story structures, and the final story entry.

### Active
- Add application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing code references runtime components such as `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect their expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected UI structure, key element IDs, scene renderer, settings, survivor/endings/story structures, and the final story entry.

### Active
- Add application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing code references runtime components such as `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect their expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected UI structure, key element IDs, scene renderer, settings, survivor/endings/story structures, and the final story entry.

### Active
- Add application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing code references runtime components such as `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect their expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` includes extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected UI structure, key element IDs, scene renderer, settings, survivor/endings/story structures, and the final story entry.

### Active
- Add application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Wire campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing code references runtime components such as `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect their expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected UI structure, key element IDs, scene renderer, settings, survivor/endings/story structures, and final story entry.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing code references runtime components such as `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect their expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected UI structure, key element IDs, scene renderer, settings, survivor/endings/story structures, final story entry, and helper interfaces.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- UI screens and many relevant controls already exist, including `#choice-list`, `#next-btn`, campaign HUD elements, sandbox setup/game elements, and navigation buttons.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected UI structure, key element IDs, scene renderer, settings, survivor/endings/story structures, final story entry, and helper interfaces.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
