## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected UI structure, key element IDs, scene renderer, settings, survivor/endings/story structures, final story entry, and helper interfaces.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- UI screens and many relevant controls already exist, including `#choice-list`, `#next-btn`, campaign HUD elements, sandbox setup/game elements, and navigation buttons.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Inspected UI structure, key element IDs, scene renderer, settings, survivor/endings/story structures, final story entry, and helper interfaces.
- A subagent checked structural validity: no JS syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting were found.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`; currently the script ends immediately after the story array with `</script>`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story data includes a `trust: 0` field where `tr` may be expected, and `{namenshalber}` appears without a `genderize()` replacement.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural check found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Existing runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story data includes a `trust: 0` field where `tr` may be expected, and `{namenshalber}` appears without a `genderize()` replacement.
- Story choice effects include fields such as `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Inspected key runtime scaffolding and screen/control IDs; identified existing navigation calls that depend on unimplemented functions.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story data includes a `trust: 0` field where `tr` may be expected, and `{namenshalber}` appears without a `genderize()` replacement.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime interfaces and screen markup have been inspected.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect runtime interfaces and implement missing gameplay/application logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story data includes a `trust: 0` field where `tr` may be expected, and `{namenshalber}` appears without a `genderize()` replacement.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime interfaces and screen markup have been inspected.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect runtime interfaces and implement missing gameplay/application logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story data includes a `trust: 0` field where `tr` may be expected, and `{namenshalber}` appears without a `genderize()` replacement.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime interfaces and screen markup have been inspected.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect runtime interfaces and implement missing gameplay/application logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story data includes a `trust: 0` field where `tr` may be expected, and `{namenshalber}` appears without a `genderize()` replacement.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime interfaces and screen markup have been inspected.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect runtime interfaces and implement missing gameplay/application logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story data includes a `trust: 0` field where `tr` may be expected, and `{namenshalber}` appears without a `genderize()` replacement.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains extensive UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime interfaces and screen markup have been inspected.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect runtime interfaces and implement missing gameplay/application logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect existing screens and controls; validate campaign state, choices, and endings.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, address failures, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Existing launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story data includes a `trust: 0` field where `tr` may be expected, and `{namenshalber}` appears without a `genderize()` replacement.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Inspected runtime foundations, story data, and screen markup; confirmed the script ends immediately after `STORY` with no application/gameplay runtime implementation.

### Active
- Implement runtime application and gameplay logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
- Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; validate story placeholders and choice effects.
- Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
2. Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
3. Run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`; runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Recent inspection confirmed the script ends immediately after `STORY`; runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

### Active

1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.

## Relevant Files

1945: function genderize(text, survivor) {
1946:   if (!text) return '';
1947:   let out = String(text);
1948:   const map = PRONOUN_MAP[survivor && survivor.gender === 'm' ? 'm' : 'f'];
1949:   for (const k in map) out = out.split(k).join(map[k]);
1950:   out = out.replace(/\{name\}/g, survivor ? survivor.name : 'SUBJEKT 09')
1951:            .replace(/\{Name\}/g, survivor ? survivor.name : 'Subjekt 09')
1952:            .replace(/\{role\}/g, survivor ? survivor.role : 'unbekannt')
1953:            .replace(/\{age\}/g, survivor ? survivor.age : '—');
1954:   return out;
1955: }

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed; no browser validation or screenshot inspection is recorded.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.
