messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains the UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains the UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect UI event hooks and existing runtime references, then implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define missing `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- `renderOptions()` is called by `updateSetting()` but is not defined; `refreshMenuState()` is called by `showScreen()` but is not defined.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.
- Inspected UI hooks and runtime references; confirmed `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are called but not defined.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.
- Inspected UI hooks and runtime references; confirmed `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are called but not defined.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed.
- Inspected UI hooks and runtime references; confirmed `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are called but not defined.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.

## Next Move
1. Implement the missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Test story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

1947:   let out = String(text);
1948:   const map = PRONOUN_MAP[survivor && survivor.gender === 'm' ? 'm' : 'f'];

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.

- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.

- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are called but not defined.

## Next Move
1. Implement missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected lost person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign uses seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI/CSS and screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Confirmed Chromium is installed and inspected UI hooks and runtime references.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing screen controls and repair data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and `{namenshalber}`.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script currently ends immediately after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are called but not defined.

## Next Move
1. Implement missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` includes screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Chromium is installed; UI hooks, campaign elements, and runtime references have been inspected.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing controls and address data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and missing `{namenshalber}` handling.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends immediately after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but not defined.

## Next Move
1. Implement missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG about rescuing a randomly selected person through consequential decisions.
- Validate it in a browser and capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign, multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` includes screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Chromium is installed; UI hooks, campaign elements, and runtime references have been inspected.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, including campaign state, choices, resources, endings, screen navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing controls and address data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and missing `{namenshalber}` handling.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends immediately after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but not defined.

## Next Move
1. Implement missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, then validate it in a browser and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime references and campaign/sandbox UI controls were inspected.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing controls and address data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and missing `{namenshalber}` handling.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends immediately after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but not defined.

## Next Move
1. Implement missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI screens for menu, campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, credits, and endings.
- Story data for seven acts of ten transmissions has been added; malformed messages in `a2_08` were corrected.
- Core utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data are present.
- Structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime references and campaign/sandbox UI controls were inspected.

### Active
- Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, and sandbox interactions.
- Connect existing controls and address data/placeholder mismatches, including `trust` versus `tr` and missing `{namenshalber}` handling.
- Validate JavaScript and browser behavior, then capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends immediately after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but not defined.

## Next Move
1. Implement missing runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; UI, runtime foundations, and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-capture.mjs`.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper using `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Runtime references include `Campaign`, `Scene`, `renderOptions`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`; inspect expected interfaces before adding implementations.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI screens, utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data for seven acts of ten transmissions.
- Prior structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.

### Active
- Implement runtime gameplay after `STORY`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, sandbox interactions, and connect existing controls.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; run syntax and browser checks, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but undefined.

## Next Move
1. Inspect expected interfaces for `Campaign`, `Scene`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`, then implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; runtime foundations and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI screens, utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data for seven acts of ten transmissions.
- Prior structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Recent inspection identified UI action entry points and choice effects; the final story transmission offers escape, stay, or abandon endings.

### Active
- Implement runtime gameplay after `STORY`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, sandbox interactions, and connect existing controls.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; run syntax and browser checks, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but undefined.

## Next Move
1. Inspect expected interfaces for `Campaign`, `Scene`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`, then implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; runtime foundations and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.
- `showScreen()` invokes `refreshMenuState()` on menu navigation; `Scene` is initially `null` and campaign survivor rendering reads `Campaign.run.survivor`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI screens, utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data for seven acts of ten transmissions.
- Prior structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime data and DOM entry points have been inspected; settings and archive persistence are defined.

### Active
- Implement runtime gameplay after `STORY`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, sandbox interactions, and connect existing controls.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; run syntax and browser checks, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but undefined.

## Next Move
1. Inspect expected interfaces for `Campaign`, `Scene`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`, then implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; runtime foundations and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.
- `showScreen()` invokes `refreshMenuState()` on menu navigation; `Scene` is initially `null` and campaign survivor rendering reads `Campaign.run.survivor`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI screens, utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data for seven acts of ten transmissions.
- Prior structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime data and DOM entry points have been inspected; settings and archive persistence are defined.

### Active
- Implement runtime gameplay after `STORY`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, sandbox interactions, and connect existing controls.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; run syntax and browser checks, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but undefined.

## Next Move
1. Inspect expected interfaces for `Campaign`, `Scene`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`, then implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; runtime foundations and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.
- `showScreen()` invokes `refreshMenuState()` on menu navigation; `Scene` is initially `null` and campaign survivor rendering reads `Campaign.run.survivor`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI screens, utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data for seven acts of ten transmissions.
- Prior structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime data and DOM entry points have been inspected; settings and archive persistence are defined.

### Active
- Implement runtime gameplay after `STORY`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, sandbox interactions, and connect existing controls.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; run syntax and browser checks, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but undefined.

## Next Move
1. Inspect expected interfaces for `Campaign`, `Scene`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`, then implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; runtime foundations and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.
- `showScreen()` invokes `refreshMenuState()` on menu navigation; `Scene` is initially `null` and campaign survivor rendering reads `Campaign.run.survivor`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI screens, utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data for seven acts of ten transmissions.
- Prior structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime data and DOM entry points have been inspected; settings and archive persistence are defined.

### Active
- Implement runtime gameplay after `STORY`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, sandbox interactions, and connect existing controls.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; run syntax and browser checks, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but undefined.

## Next Move
1. Inspect expected interfaces for `Campaign`, `Scene`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`, then implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; runtime foundations and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.
- `showScreen()` invokes `refreshMenuState()` on menu navigation; `Scene` is initially `null` and campaign survivor rendering reads `Campaign.run.survivor`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains UI screens, utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data for seven acts of ten transmissions.
- Prior structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime data and DOM entry points have been inspected; settings and archive persistence are defined.

### Active
- Implement runtime gameplay after `STORY`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, sandbox interactions, and connect existing controls.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; run syntax and browser checks, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but undefined.

## Next Move
1. Inspect expected interfaces for `Campaign`, `Scene`, `saveArchive`, and `checkAchievements`, then implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows; define `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; runtime foundations and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.
- `showScreen()` invokes `refreshMenuState()` on menu navigation; `Scene` is initially `null` and campaign survivor rendering reads `Campaign.run.survivor`.

## Objective
- Complete **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, a playable single-file HTML5 mobile text RPG, and validate it in a browser with a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Portrait 9:16, mobile-first one- or two-finger controls, and more than five customizable control themes.
- Seven-hour campaign with multiple difficulties, leaderboard, phone-style notifications and decisions, sound, and animated main menu.
- Dark sci-fi cyberpunk atmosphere with an unobstructed play area.
- Graphics settings: Sparsam, Ausbalanciert, Hoch, Unnötig Ultra Hoch.
- Power-ups, procedural levels, extras, and configurable sandbox.
- Rescuable person can be a woman or man; choices can lead to survival or death.
- Deliver as one copyable HTML file.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (maximum width 1280 px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- German-language game title: **TODESFUNK // ORBITAL 9**, by BANDOS7.
- Campaign structure: seven acts with ten transmissions each, three choices per transmission, resource/risk consequences, and multiple endings.
- `index.html` holds the single-file UI, utilities, settings, survivor data, and story data.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` contains the UI screens, utilities, settings, audio engine, scene renderer, survivor/difficulty/control-theme data, endings, achievements, codex, and story data for seven acts of ten transmissions.
- Prior structural checks found no JavaScript syntax errors, duplicate HTML IDs, or malformed tag nesting.
- Runtime data and DOM entry points have been inspected, including settings and archive persistence.

### Active
- Implement runtime gameplay after `STORY`: campaign state, choices, resources, endings, navigation, options, sandbox interactions, and connect existing controls.
- Validate story placeholders and choice effects; run syntax and browser checks, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

### Blocked
- Runtime gameplay/application implementation is missing; the script ends after `STORY`.
- `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()` are referenced but undefined.

## Next Move
1. Implement runtime logic after `STORY` in `index.html`, defining `renderOptions()` and `refreshMenuState()`.
2. Connect campaign, sandbox, leaderboard, archive, options, notifications, and interaction flows.
3. Check story placeholders and choice effects, run syntax and browser tests, fix issues, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; runtime foundations and story data.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot helper.
- `start.sh`: Launch helper.
- `startup.sh`: Existing launch-related helper.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Story choice effects include `tr`, `o2`, `sig`, `vit`, `med`, `scrap`, `score`, and `flag`; some choices also define `risk`, `fail`, `ending`, or `final`.
- `genderize()` handles pronoun and name placeholders but does not replace `{namenshalber}`.
- `showScreen()` invokes `refreshMenuState()` when navigating to the menu; `Scene` starts as `null`, and campaign survivor rendering reads `Campaign.run.survivor`.
- `saveArchive()` and `checkAchievements()` are defined.
